reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles the missing, numeric and furthest-from-zero range cases, instead of re-deriving the rule.

duplication.why: A single call; no logic is copied.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API model layer that already maps schedule entities to their external shape, with the rule left in shared/schedules.

scope.why: Only the API type, the mapping line, a focused test and the release note the repo expects.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule in getScheduledAmount flows automatically into the API field.
